images.title: Four parts of 25 × 32
images.purpose: Shows 25 × 32 as a rectangle cut into four parts, 23 × 27, 23 × 5, 2 × 27 and 2 × 5, one for each pair of terms.
images.composition: One large rectangle centred, split by one vertical and one horizontal line into four parts. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: A rectangle 32 units wide and 25 units tall, split by a vertical line 27 units from the left and a horizontal line 23 units from the top. Top left part (27 by 23) teal (#0072B2) with the label '621' inside. Top right part (5 by 23) amber (#E69F00) with the label '115' inside. Bottom left part (27 by 2) amber with the label '54' just below it. Bottom right part (5 by 2) reddish purple (#CC79A7) with the label '10' just below it. Along the top edge, the label '27' over the left part and '5' over the right part. Along the left edge, the label '23' beside the upper part and '2' beside the lower part. Exactly 4 parts.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.description: Shows 25 × 32 as a rectangle cut into four parts, 23 × 27, 23 × 5, 2 × 27 and 2 × 5, one for each pair of terms.

image_decisions.why: The four regions are the four products, so the picture shows why two terms times two terms give four terms.
